name: @wasmos/abi
description: Generated WASI / wasmos_kernel ABI bindings. The contents of generated/ (kernel.js + .core*.wasm + .d.ts) are jco-transpiled build output (gitignored) produced by `npm run binder gen` from the kernel component, and loaded at runtime by the kernel worker via /packages/abi/generated/kernel.js. This manifest exists so the directory is a well-formed npm workspace member (root workspaces: packages/*).
